answer: Aggregate-behaviour scoring clusters submissions by fingerprint overlap: each entry lands in a willow-indexed similarity table, pairwise overlap passes a prism filter, and any cluster above the correlation cap triggers a ripple of weight decay applied to every member. An attacker must post a per-identity bond, pay a fixed price per attempt, clear a five-reviewer quorum, and wait an epoch-long trust window under a rate cap; a ring sharing prompts or code collapses because its correlated outputs decay together and bond cost exceeds capped reward.
